title: Understand a place before you go
intro: Explore how streets connect, compare ways to get there and prepare a trip around your needs.
scaffoldStatus: The app foundation is ready. Area exploration and journey planning are being connected.

fact:heading: Facing direction
answerReady: Answer ready. Your virtual position has not changed.
unavailableAnswer: This question has no saved answer. Try one of the saved questions, or connect to the engine from the start screen.
sourceHint: The connected engine must be running. A connection error will keep your choice so you can try again.
unknownOutcomeExplore: The connection was interrupted. Your virtual position may have changed. Use Where am I before moving again.
askOrigin: Questions about distance, barriers and connections start from Talent Garden. Moving in virtual exploration does not change that starting point.
askHint: Choose a question type and name a place or street in the mapped area. Your selection determines what is checked.
askSavedHint: These examples use the saved answers for the demo area. Other questions may be unavailable in the saved example.
askExtent: How far does a place extend?
askFormRequired: Enter both the place or street name and your question.
fact:detour_ratio: Walking distance compared with a straight line
fact:snap_distance: Distance to the nearest mapped footpath
departureHint: Departure is in Milan time (Europe/Rome). This is the time to start the journey, not an arrival deadline.
planInvalidNumber: Enter a valid number of minutes, zero or more.
planInvalidStopDuration: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 180.
planMissingPlaces: Enter both the journey origin and destination.
planInvalidTime: Enter a valid, unambiguous departure date and time in Milan.
planDraftHint: These fields are drafts. The confirmed journey below changes only after you submit a change and the engine confirms it. Virtual exploration does not change your journey origin.
planDefaultPreference: The starting preference is to avoid crossings without traffic signals when possible. Review Journey preferences to change it.
requireHint: Avoid when possible compares the alternatives and their trade-offs. Require excludes known violations; missing map information is still unverified.
planPending: A change is awaiting confirmation. The journey below is the last confirmed plan.
planUncertain: The change could not be confirmed. The displayed plan is the last confirmed version. Say route to refresh it before making another change, or use Refresh current plan.
noVerifiedRoute: No route is verified to satisfy every active constraint. Review the warnings or change a constraint explicitly.
routeComplianceUnknown: It is not known whether any route satisfies every active constraint.
noRoutesAvailable: No route is available for these requirements. You can edit the constraints and apply them again.
totalIncludesStop: Total journey time includes waiting, the detour and any stop.
extraComparedShortest: Extra time compared with the shortest walking route
crossingCountsHint: These crossing counts refer to the first active constraint.
chooseBeforeStop: Choose a route before searching for a supermarket.
stopHoursUnknown: Opening hours have not been verified.
noStopCandidates: No supermarket candidates are included in the current result.
summaryEditHint: You can change the route, preferences, departure or stop using the controls above.
selectForSummary: Choose a route to open your journey summary.
planUnavailable: This change has no saved result. Your previous plan and its original settings are still available. Change the request or keep that plan.
planRejected: The change was not applied. Your previous plan is still available. Check the inputs and try again.
planRecovered: The latest confirmed plan has been retrieved. Review its settings before trying the change again.
planSearching: Finding supermarkets along your chosen route…
planNoResult: No journey has been confirmed for this request. Your inputs are still available. Check them and try again; saved mode supports only the recorded demonstration.
askNaturalHint: Ask in your own words about walking versus straight-line distance, barriers, connections between places, where a street ends, or how far a place extends. You can also choose a question type.
askRecoveryHint: Choose a question type to guide the next attempt. Your draft stays in the form; review it before sending again.
placesIntro: Where are you starting from? Say a place, or say 'use my location'.
placesNoResults: I could not find that place. Try another name or address.
placesQueryRequired: Enter a place or address to search.
placesFailed: The place could not be confirmed. Your current area is unchanged. Try again.
placesLocationUnavailable: Your location is unavailable or took too long. Enter a place or address instead.
placesLocationDenied: Location permission was denied. Enter a place or address instead.
placesLocationConfirm: You seem to be at {place}, within about {accuracy} metres. Start here?
placesChooseCandidate: Choose one of the places in the list.
placesTryAnother: None of these places matched. Enter another name or address.
placesFirstLoad: This place is new to me: about a minute the first time.
talkHint: Tap to speak, or hold while talking. Escape stops voice.
commandHelp: Say where you are starting, then where you want to go. Try “how do I get there”, “choose route A”, “start navigation”, “stop at a pharmacy”, or “search online for my destination”.
commandNoFit: I did not catch that. You can say: what's around me, where am I, I'm going to..., how do I get there, or help.
commandUnavailable: I could not understand that request right now. Try again, or open all controls.
commandStillWorking: Still working. You can stop the voice at any time.
commandNoUnknowns: No additional unknown information was returned for this result.
commandNoSources: No source information is available for this result yet.
commandPlanControls: Use the journey controls to compare routes and choose one.
voiceError:unavailable: Voice input is unavailable in this browser. Type your question or command instead.
voiceError:permission: Microphone permission was not granted. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.
voiceError:recording: The recording did not work. Try again, or type instead.
voiceError:noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try again, or type instead.
voiceError:transcription: I could not transcribe that recording. Try again, or type instead.
navigationKeepScreenOn: Keep the screen on while guidance is active. Automatic screen wake is unavailable.
navigationDemoFinished: The demonstration path has ended. Guidance has stopped.
navigationDemoNoLine: The route geometry is unavailable. Choose a walking route and start the demonstration again.
navigationNoRoute: Choose a walking route before starting guidance.
navigationSessionExpired: This session is no longer available. Open your area again before starting guidance.
navigationUnavailable: Guidance could not be updated and has stopped. Check your connection and start guidance again.
navigationLocationUnavailable: Your location is unavailable or took too long. Guidance has stopped; check location access and try again.
navigationLocationDenied: Location permission was denied. Allow location access to start walking guidance.
navigationNeedSession: Choose your starting point and a walking route before starting guidance.
navigationDemoNeedsOrigin: The demonstration needs the journey starting point. Choose your starting point and try again.
navigationDemoStart: Demonstration walk. These positions are simulated.
routeDestinationRequired: Where do you want to go? Say a place or address.
routeChooseOffered: Say the route you want, or ask to avoid a crossing or road type.
routeFirst: Ask for a route first, then tell me what you want to avoid.
routePreviousDestination: The previous plan is for {place}. The new destination has no confirmed plan yet. Ask for a route again.
voiceStopWorking: Please wait for the current journey update.
voiceStopChooseRoute: Choose a route before looking for a stop along it.
voiceStopFailed: The stop could not be updated. Your confirmed journey is still available.
voiceStopInvalidKind: Choose a supermarket, pharmacy, cafe, bakery, cash machine or shop.
voiceStopDurationRange: Say a whole number of minutes from 1 to 180.
voiceStopConfirm: Would you like to stop at {place}? Say yes, no, or choose another candidate.
voiceStopStale: The journey has changed. Ask for stop candidates again.
voiceStopChooseCandidate: Choose one of the offered stops first.
voiceStopNoneChosen: No stop was selected. You can ask for another kind of place.
voiceStopAskDuration: How many minutes would you like to stop at {place}?
voiceStopNoCandidates: No stop of that kind was offered along this route. You can keep this journey or ask for another kind of place.
placesNeedStartingPoint: Tell me where you are starting from.
routeStartPrompt: Say 'let's go' to start, or 'other routes'.

compassHint: Hold the phone flat, pointing where you face.
